sentences.en: There's a new season of The Morning Show on Apple TV+, which she stars in and also co-executive produces.
sentences.zh: Apple TV+ 上正在热播《早间新闻》的新一季，她既是主演也是联合监制。

sentences.en: She's also written a new book with Harlan Coben, a thriller about a surgeon who gets swept up in international intrigue, publishing next month.
sentences.zh: 她还与哈兰·科本合著了一本新书，这是一部惊悚小说，讲述了一位被卷入国际阴谋的外科医生的故事，将于下个月出版。

sentences.en: But as she told me, her true passion these days is Hello Sunshine, the production company she founded.
sentences.zh: 但正如她告诉我的，她如今真正的热情在于她创立的制片公司“阳光之光”（Hello Sunshine）。

sentences.en: The company, which focuses on stories by and for women, has been a producer for shows like
sentences.zh: 这家公司专注于讲述由女性创作并以女性为主角的故事，曾制作过诸如

sentences.en: Big Little Lies and Daisy Jones and the Six.
sentences.zh: 《大小谎言》和《黛西与乐队》等剧集。

sentences.en: Witherspoon sold it for almost a billion dollars back in 2021, but she's still deeply involved
sentences.zh: 威瑟斯彭在2021年以近十亿美元的价格将其出售，但她依然深深参与

sentences.en: in its day-to-day operations, and she's the face of its massively popular book club too.
sentences.zh: 其日常运营，并且她也是其极受欢迎的读书俱乐部的门面担当。

sentences.en: In our wide-ranging and candid conversation, she reminisced about her early days in Hollywood as a young mother, the professional slump she faced after winning an Oscar, becoming
sentences.zh: 在我们广泛而坦诚的对话中，她回忆了早年作为年轻母亲在好莱坞的日子、她赢得奥斯卡奖后面临的职业低谷、成为

sentences.en: a boss, and how she's navigating the turbulent environment in Hollywood these days.
sentences.zh: 一名老板的经历，以及她如今是如何在好莱坞动荡的环境中破浪前行的。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Reese Witherspoon.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与瑞茜·威瑟斯彭的对话。

sentences.en: I want to start by asking you about your most recent projects.
sentences.zh: 我想先问问你最近的项目。

sentences.en: You have just co-authored a thriller.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚联手创作了一部惊悚小说。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I've seen you talk about collaboration before.
sentences.zh: 我以前看你谈过合作的话题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: There was an interview that you gave where you said, you know, if you don't want to collaborate, if you're an actor, then you should go write a book.
sentences.zh: 你曾经在一次采访中说，你知道的，如果你不想合作，如果你是个演员，那你应该去写书。

sentences.en: But you actually wrote a book in collaboration with someone.
sentences.zh: 但你实际上是与别人合作写了一本书。

sentences.en: So talk me through that.
sentences.zh: 所以跟我聊聊这个过程吧。

sentences.en: Yes, you're right.
sentences.zh: 是的，你说的对。

sentences.en: Oh, gosh.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Okay, well, this idea came from so many different places.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这个想法来自很多不同的地方。

sentences.en: My parents are both in the medical field, and I grew up as a military brat.
sentences.zh: 我的父母都在医疗领域工作，我在军人家庭长大。

sentences.en: My dad was stationed in Germany when I was a little girl.
sentences.zh: 我小的时候，我爸爸被派驻在德国。

sentences.en: And so first five years of my life, I grew up on an Army base, Air Force base, actually.
sentences.zh: 所以我的前五年是在陆军基地，其实是空军基地度过的。

sentences.en: Do you remember that?
sentences.zh: 你还记得那个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得。

sentences.en: I went to German school, and it was a great upbringing in terms of exposure to other languages and other cultures, but also to all these medical service people, like they were
sentences.zh: 我上过德国学校，从接触其他语言和文化的角度来看，这是一段很棒的成长经历，同时我也接触到了所有这些医务人员，比如他们在

sentences.en: working in the hospitals.
sentences.zh: 医院里工作。

sentences.en: My mother was a nurse.
sentences.zh: 我母亲是一名护士。

sentences.en: My dad was a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我父亲是一名医生。

sentences.en: So I always thought, why are there not more stories about surgeons?
sentences.zh: 所以我总是在想，为什么关于外科医生的故事没有更多一些呢？

sentences.en: We should say at this point, the main character is a plastic surgeon.
sentences.zh: 我们此时应该说明一下，主角是一位整形外科医生。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: She's a reconstructive surgeon.
sentences.zh: 她是一名重建外科医生。

sentences.en: Reconstructive surgeon.
sentences.zh: 重建外科医生。

sentences.en: She's a military-trained doctor.
sentences.zh: 她是一位受过军事训练的医生。

sentences.en: She's sort of down on her luck.
sentences.zh: 她有点时运不济。

sentences.en: She's lost her medical license.
sentences.zh: 她失去了行医执照。

sentences.en: Her husband has kind of disappeared.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫也莫名失踪了。

sentences.en: And she gets pulled into this world that you're sort of describing where she ends up with oligarchs and in very shady areas.
sentences.zh: 然后她被卷入了你刚刚描述的那种世界，最后和寡头们纠缠在一起，进入了非常阴暗的领域。

sentences.en: Yeah, the CIA gets involved, and there's this whole hidden world.
sentences.zh: 是的，中情局也介入了，这里面藏着一个完整的隐秘世界。

sentences.en: Yeah, so this idea kind of came up through that, thinking about my parents.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这个想法就是通过这些经历萌生的，我想到了我的父母。

sentences.en: And then I started thinking, well, who would I want to write it?
sentences.zh: 然后我开始想，好吧，我想让谁来和我一起写？

sentences.en: Well, I've got to have a thriller co-author with me, because I'm too invested here to just give this idea away.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我得找一个惊悚小说家跟我共同署名，因为我对这个想法投入太深了，不可能直接把它送人。

sentences.en: So I met Harlan nine years ago at a conference, and I called him and I said, I have an idea for a thriller.
sentences.zh: 九年前我在一次会议上遇到了哈兰，我给他打电话说，我有一个写惊悚小说的点子。

sentences.en: And I was so nervous, because I have such high regard for authors and their process and how difficult it is to create characters and story.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常紧张，因为我对作家以及他们的创作流程、塑造人物和故事有多么艰难有着无比崇高的敬意。

sentences.en: And I went through a whole litany of insecurities.
sentences.zh: 我当时经历了一连串的不安全感。

sentences.en: But part of my, the way I process things is I'm, even if there's risk there, I kind of jump into the risk.
sentences.zh: 但我的部分处理方式是，即使存在风险，我也倾向于一头扎进风险里。

sentences.en: And sometimes I fail, but I'd rather take the risk.
sentences.zh: 有时我会失败，但我宁愿去冒这个险。

sentences.en: So I was like, okay, Reese, you've read more books.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，好吧，瑞茜，你读过更多书。

sentences.en: You know how to plot a movie.
sentences.zh: 你知道如何构思一部电影的情节。

sentences.en: So take your knowledge of building character and understanding narrative structure, and just keep imparting it.
sentences.zh: 所以，运用你对塑造人物和理解叙事结构的知识，继续把它灌输进去。

sentences.en: I think the through thread between this character in your book and The Morning Show is that they are both sort of helmed by very complicated women.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你书中的这个角色与《早间新闻》之间的贯通线索是，她们都是由非常复杂的女性来掌舵的。

sentences.en: The Morning Show is now back for its fourth season.
sentences.zh: 《早间新闻》现在迎来了第四季。

sentences.en: And the women are finally in charge now at UBN.
sentences.zh: 而且在UBN，女性现在终于掌权了。

sentences.en: And one of the themes definitely this season is that putting women at the top doesn't necessarily solve everyone's probleMs.
sentences.zh: 本季的一个主题毫无疑问是，把女性推上高位并不一定能解决所有人的问题。

sentences.en: As someone who sort of prides themselves in working with women, is that something that resonated from your own experience, this idea that somehow just putting women in charge
sentences.zh: 作为以与女性共事为傲的人，这是否契合了你自身的经历——这种认为仅仅让女性掌舵

sentences.en: isn't going to be the panacea that maybe everyone thinks it's going to be?
sentences.zh: 并不一定会成为每个人想象中的灵丹妙药的想法？

sentences.en: Well, I've never advocated for a matriarchy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我从未倡导过母系社会。

sentences.en: I've always thought the world needs gender balance.
sentences.zh: 我一直认为世界需要性别平衡。

sentences.en: We've gotten out of balance.
sentences.zh: 我们已经失衡了。

sentences.en: Things swing too far one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 事情往往会向某个方向倾斜得太远。

sentences.en: And I don't think that, I don't think that trying to portray a, I don't know what I'm trying to say.
sentences.zh: 而且我不认为，我不认为试图去描绘一个……我不知道我在说什么。

sentences.en: Every, every time I have the chance to talk about culture inside of Hello Sunshine, I never want to create a monoculture.
sentences.zh: 每次我有机会谈论“阳光之光”内部的文化时，我都绝不想创造一种单一文化。

sentences.en: You know, and I'm also raising two boys.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，而且我还在抚养两个男孩。

sentences.en: It's really important that we include men in these conversations and young men.
sentences.zh: 把男性以及年轻男性纳入这些对话中是非常重要的。

sentences.en: And I do think a lot of language and a lot of media during, from 2017 to 2020, did not include their consciousness and ask them in and help them feel like they belonged in the
sentences.zh: 而且我确实认为，在2017年至2020年期间，很多话语和很多媒体并没有将他们的意识纳入其中，没有邀请他们进来，也没有让他们觉得自己属于

sentences.en: emergence of the power of women.
sentences.zh: 女性力量崛起的一部分。

sentences.en: And so I think we're seeing them look for other sources of empowerment.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们看到他们在寻找其他赋权来源。

sentences.en: And maybe those are empty sources.
sentences.zh: 也许那些是空洞的来源。

sentences.en: Maybe they don't have, maybe they aren't substantive, but they're speaking the right language to young men.
sentences.zh: 也许它们不具备实质内容，但它们对年轻男性说对了话。

sentences.en: So I think we have to invite an idea of gender balance.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们必须引入性别平衡的概念。

sentences.en: That's what feels like what's right in the world to me.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这才是世界上正确的事情。

sentences.en: I think I pushed really hard to get women in seats of power all around me because they weren't getting the opportunities at all.
sentences.zh: 我想我非常努力地让周围的权力宝座上都有女性，因为她们根本没有得到机会。

sentences.en: And I was trying to show it more.
sentences.zh: 而我正试图更多地展现这一点。

sentences.en: Women in charge, women as directors, women as screenwriters, women as the author of that bestselling book.
sentences.zh: 掌控大局的女性、身为导演的女性、身为编剧的女性、那本畅销书的女性作者。

sentences.en: So yeah, it's interesting that we're exploring on Morning Show the dynamics of having all these women in charge.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们在《早间新闻》中探讨让所有这些女性掌权的动态，这很有意思。

sentences.en: And that, that isn't always the final answer.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不总是最终答案。

sentences.en: One of the things though, when I was looking at the show is this question of, do women deal with power differently?
sentences.zh: 不过，当我审视这部剧时，其中一个问题是：女性对待权力的处理方式是否有所不同？

sentences.en: And it made me wonder about, as someone who was in charge of her own company, do you think that there is a different way in which women actually exercise power?
sentences.zh: 这让我不禁在想，作为一个掌管自己公司的女性，你认为女性实际行使权力的独特方式吗？

sentences.en: Or do you think that's just like a myth?
sentences.zh: 还是你觉得这纯属无稽之谈？

sentences.en: No, I do think it's different.
sentences.zh: 不，我确实认为它是不同的。

sentences.en: I have a very troubled relationship with the word power because it's got so much weight on it.
sentences.zh: 我对“权力”这个词有着非常困扰的关系，因为它承载了太多的分量。

sentences.en: Explain.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: It doesn't feel like something I wanted to achieve or grab at or grasp for.
sentences.zh: 它不像是我想去实现、去攫取或去抓紧的东西。

sentences.en: It feels like it could corrupt you, you know, corrode you from the inside, your desire for power in some sort of Lord of the Rings way, like greed and power.
sentences.zh: 它感觉会腐蚀你，你知道的，从内部侵蚀你，就像《指环王》里那种对贪婪和权力的欲望。

sentences.en: No, I love leadership and learning to be a good leader is something I've had to do over the past eight years because I did not, I'm not the person to raise my hand and say, oh,
sentences.zh: 不，我热爱领导力，而学会成为一个优秀的领导者是我在过去八年里不得不去做的事情，因为我并不是那种会举手说“哦，

sentences.en: I want to be in charge.
sentences.zh: 我想当领导”的人。

sentences.en: It feels like it would be my personality.
sentences.zh: 这感觉不符合我的个性。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 其实不是。

sentences.en: What have you learned about leadership?
sentences.zh: 关于领导力你学到了什么？

sentences.en: Then I got to step up and do it.
sentences.zh: 然后我不得不挺身而出去做这件事。

sentences.en: You know, I had a really pivotal conversation in my life with Shonda Rhimes and we were sitting in a forum with a lot of women and it was in 2017 and it was about, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我的生活中有过一次极其关键的对话，对象是珊达·瑞姆斯，当时我们和许多女性坐在一起开会，那是在2017年，主题是关于

sentences.en: helping people in our business come forward with their stories of sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 帮助我们行业里的人勇敢站出来，讲述他们遭受性骚扰的故事。

sentences.en: And abuse in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 以及职场虐待。

sentences.en: And I said, if we could just get people to show up at this one event, then that would be great.
sentences.zh: 我说，如果我们能让大家出席这单一的活动，那就太棒了。

sentences.en: And so somebody is going to have to get them there.
sentences.zh: 所以总得有人把他们召集到那里。

sentences.en: And she goes, you're going to do it.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，你来做这件事。

sentences.en: And I said, what?
sentences.zh: 我说，什么？

sentences.en: She goes, she patted my leg and she goes, you're going to do it.
sentences.zh: 她说，她拍了拍我的腿说，你来做这件事。

sentences.en: They're going to listen to you.
sentences.zh: 他们会听你的。

sentences.en: And when you tell them to show up on Thursday at 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 当你在周四下午5点

sentences.en: at your office, they're going to come because you're the leader and you don't know it.
sentences.zh: 通知他们到你的办公室集合时，他们会来的，因为你是领导者，而你对此还一无所知。

sentences.en: And that was a big moment for me because it was scary too.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说是一个重大的时刻，因为这也让人感到害怕。

sentences.en: It's a responsibility that you don't always want to put that hat on.
sentences.zh: 这是一种责任，你并不总是想戴上那顶帽子。

sentences.en: But I was like, okay.
sentences.zh: 但我当时想，好吧。

sentences.en: I kind of thought in my mind, okay, if I don't do this, who's going to do it?
sentences.zh: 我在脑海里琢磨，好吧，如果我不做这件事，谁来做？

sentences.en: That story also says something to me about mentorship and the need for someone to look at you and see that.
sentences.zh: 那个故事对我而言也说明了一些关于导师制以及有人注视着你并发现你潜力的需求。

sentences.en: I needed her to tell me that because I would not have seen it.
sentences.zh: 我需要她告诉我这一点，因为我自己根本看不出来。

sentences.en: I do lack some self-awareness.
sentences.zh: 我确实缺乏一些自我认知。

sentences.en: So the fact is she said it to me made it true in my mind.
sentences.zh: 所以她把这话对我说了出来，在我的脑海里它就成了事实。

sentences.en: I wanted to go back a little bit to your history and your career.
sentences.zh: 我想稍微回溯一下你的过往经历和职业生涯。

sentences.en: Where did you sort of first start to get in front of an audience and enjoy that?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候开始第一次走到观众面前并享受那种感觉的？

sentences.en: What was that moment?
sentences.zh: 那是怎样的一个时刻？

sentences.en: Well, I did a commercial for my neighbor down the street when I was seven.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我七岁时为街坊邻居拍了一个广告。

sentences.en: And then I don't know.
sentences.zh: 然后我不知道了。

sentences.en: I went up to my mom and I said, I want to do acting classes when I was seven.
sentences.zh: 我走到我妈妈面前对她说，我七岁时想去上表演课。

sentences.en: So she took me, she couldn't find any acting classes for kids.
sentences.zh: 于是她带我去了，但她找不到任何专为儿童开设的表演课。

sentences.en: So she enrolled me in Belmont College, had a nighttime acting class for students.
sentences.zh: 所以她给我报名了贝尔蒙特学院，那里为学生开设了夜间表演课。

sentences.en: And so I was going with, you know, 20-year-olds to acting for television and commercials.
sentences.zh: 于是我就和那些20多岁的大孩子们一起上电视与广告表演课。

sentences.en: And then I didn't do much for it until I was about 12.
sentences.zh: 然后直到我大概12岁之前，我都没有怎么演戏。

sentences.en: Another girl had told me at school, she goes, oh, I'm doing these acting classes every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 学校里的另一个女孩对我说，她去上周六早上的表演课。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, okay, well, I'm going to ask my mom if I can go.
sentences.zh: 我说，噢，好的，那我要问问我妈妈我能不能去。

sentences.en: So I went home, told my mom, and she was like, sure.
sentences.zh: 所以我回家告诉了我妈妈，她回答说，当然可以。

sentences.en: So every Saturday for probably three years, I was dropped off for three hours of acting training every Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 所以在大概三年的时间里，每个星期六，我都会被送到那里接受三个小时的表演培训，每个星期六早晨都是如此。

sentences.en: And you loved it?
sentences.zh: 你很喜欢吗？

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢。

sentences.en: We'd act.
sentences.zh: 我们会进行表演练习。

sentences.en: They taught us how to do our hair and makeup.
sentences.zh: 他们教我们如何打理发型和化妆。

sentences.en: It was Nashville.
sentences.zh: 那是纳什维尔。

sentences.en: So we had to learn how to put on, you know, our fake eyelashes.
sentences.zh: 所以我们得学会怎么戴上，你知道的，我们的假睫毛。

sentences.en: And I was 12.
sentences.zh: 当时我12岁。

sentences.en: But also they taught professionalism.
sentences.zh: 但他们同时也教导职业素养。

sentences.en: Like, how do you show up?
sentences.zh: 比如，如何出席活动？

sentences.en: How do you go for an audition?
sentences.zh: 如何去参加试镜？

sentences.en: How do you do a job interview?
sentences.zh: 如何进行求职面试？

sentences.en: And it was the only professional training I've ever had as an actor.
sentences.zh: 这是我作为演员接受过的唯一的专业培训。

sentences.en: But it was very good and very comprehensive.
sentences.zh: 但它非常棒，也非常全面。

sentences.en: Because I got a job when I was 14, starring in a movie.
sentences.zh: 因为我在14岁时就得到了一份工作，在一部电影里担任主演。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You went to an open casting call for the man in the moon.
sentences.zh: 你去参加了《月中人》的公开选角。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: Over like three blocks away in the back of a bar.
sentences.zh: 就在大概三个街区外的一家酒吧后面。

sentences.en: In the back of a bar?
sentences.zh: 在酒吧后面？

sentences.en: In the back of a bar in Nashville.
sentences.zh: 在纳什维尔的一家酒吧后面。

sentences.en: Yeah, my dad drove me down, let me get out and stand in line.
sentences.zh: 对，我爸爸开车送我过去，让我下车去排队。

sentences.en: It was 1990.
And I stood in line waiting because it was an ad in the paper that said, do you want to be in a movie?
sentences.zh: 我排着队等待，因为报纸上登了一则广告，上面写着：你想拍电影吗？

sentences.en: And there was a woman at the acting school had said, hey, they're casting for this movie.
sentences.zh: 表演学校的一位女老师曾说过，嘿，他们在为这部电影选角。

sentences.en: You should go stand in line.
sentences.zh: 你应该去排队试试。

sentences.en: So I did.
sentences.zh: 于是我就去了。

sentences.en: And it turned out they were looking for a 14-year-old Southern girl.
sentences.zh: 结果他们寻找的是一个14岁的南方女孩。

sentences.en: So right place, right time.
sentences.zh: 所以真是天时地利人和。

sentences.en: At around 18, you then put your acting career on pause and you go to college for a year.
sentences.zh: 在大约18岁时，你暂停了演艺生涯，去上了一年大学。

sentences.en: And this is actually something that I wanted to understand a little bit about because you ended up going to Stanford.
sentences.zh: 其实这也是我一直挺想了解的一点，因为你最后去了斯坦福大学。

sentences.en: Why did you end up stopping what was a promising acting career and decide, I need to go to college?
sentences.zh: 为什么你会选择停下那个本大有可为的演艺事业，决定去上大学呢？

sentences.en: Well, my parents didn't think I was going to become an actor.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的父母并不认为我会成为一名演员。

sentences.en: And so they really encouraged me to go to college.
sentences.zh: 所以他们非常鼓励我去上大学。

sentences.en: They wouldn't let me work during the school year either.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在学年期间也不让我工作。

sentences.en: I was only allowed to work on movies in the summers while I was in high school.
sentences.zh: 在上高中期间，我只被允许在暑假里拍电影。

sentences.en: They wanted me to go to traditional high school and have a normal high school experience because I got calls after the first movie I did.
sentences.zh: 他们希望我去上一所传统的高中，拥有正常的高中生活，因为在我拍完第一部电影后，我接到了很多电话。

sentences.en: I got offers to be on broadcast television shows and I turned them down.
sentences.zh: 我收到了出演电视广播节目的邀约，但我都拒绝了。

sentences.en: And I'm really glad my parents held the line with that because all those things I learned
sentences.zh: 我真的很高兴我的父母当时坚持了这一原则，因为我学到的所有那些

sentences.en: about being a kid were just formed by growing up in Nashville and going to prom and feeling awkward in the school cafeteria.
sentences.zh: 关于如何度过童年的经历，都是在纳什维尔长大、去参加毕业舞会以及在学校食堂感到局促不安中形成的。

sentences.en: But then they wanted me to go to college and applied only to schools in California.
sentences.zh: 但随后他们希望我去上大学，并且只允许我申请加州的学校。

sentences.en: And back then we didn't go on college tours or I didn't.
sentences.zh: 那时候我们可不会去实地考察大学，或者说我没有去。

sentences.en: So there was this giant thick book and they had little thumbnail prints of colleges.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有一本厚重无比的书，里面印着各大院校的小缩略图。

sentences.en: And there was a picture of Stanford and I was like, I guess I'll go there.
sentences.zh: 上面有一张斯坦福的照片，我就想，好吧，那我就去那儿吧。

sentences.en: It's in California.
sentences.zh: 它在加州。

sentences.en: I think I was the only person from Tennessee in my entire freshman class.
sentences.zh: 我想我整个大一新生里是唯一一个来自田纳西州的人。

sentences.en: I always say, I think I got on geographic diversity.
sentences.zh: 我常说，我觉得我是靠地理多样性被录取的。

sentences.en: What did you think you were going to study?
sentences.zh: 你当时觉得自己会学什么专业？

sentences.en: Like, what did you want to...
sentences.zh: 比如，你想去……

sentences.en: Literature.
sentences.zh: 文学。

sentences.en: I loved reading.
sentences.zh: 我热爱阅读。

sentences.en: I just read and read and read.
sentences.zh: 我就是不停地读、读、读。

sentences.en: I wanted to study literature.
sentences.zh: 我想研究文学。

sentences.en: You only stayed for a year.
sentences.zh: 你只读了一年。

sentences.en: How come?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, I couldn't afford it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我承担不起学费。

sentences.en: I didn't have any money to go to college.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何钱去上大学。

sentences.en: My grandparents had given me $8,000, which was so generous.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母给了我8000美元，这真是太慷慨了。

sentences.en: But it didn't cover my tuition.
sentences.zh: 但它根本不够付学费。

sentences.en: I remember it was $33,000 with room and board.
sentences.zh: 我记得算上食宿费一共是33000美元。

sentences.en: Seems like a bargain now.
sentences.zh: 现在看来这简直像个大便宜。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: But I couldn't afford it.
sentences.zh: 但我当时确实付不起。

sentences.en: So I had to figure out how I'd get an acting job to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须想办法找份演戏的工作来支付学费。

sentences.en: So I left to go get an acting job.
sentences.zh: 于是我离开学校去接演艺工作了。

sentences.en: I got one.
sentences.zh: 我接到了一个。

sentences.en: And I ended up doing three movies in a row, Pleasantville, Election, and Cruel Intentions.
sentences.zh: 结果我接连拍了三部电影，《欢乐谷》、《选举风暴》和《危险性游戏》。

sentences.en: And then by the time I had finished those three films, it had been a year and a half.
sentences.zh: 等我拍完这三部电影时，已经过去了一年半。

sentences.en: And also you were legit famous.
sentences.zh: 而且当时你已经是名正言顺的大明星了。

sentences.en: Well, I wouldn't say I was really famous until I did Legally Blonde.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不会说自己当时有多红，直到我演了《律政俏佳人》。

sentences.en: But those three movies were, you know, big movies.
sentences.zh: 但那三部电影，你知道的，都是大制作。

sentences.en: And you just decided at that point, like, maybe the college experience wasn't for you?
sentences.zh: 你在那个时候就决定，大学生活可能并不适合你吗？

sentences.en: Did it?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: No, I thought I was going back.
sentences.zh: 不，我本打算回去的。

sentences.en: I fully thought I was going back for probably five, six years.
sentences.zh: 我完全以为自己可能会回去读个五六年。

sentences.en: I wanted to ask you about a more difficult moment.
sentences.zh: 我想问你一个比较艰难的时刻。

sentences.en: I saw you in Oprah in 2018 talk about leaving an abusive relationship when you were very young.
sentences.zh: 我看到你在2018年的奥普拉访谈节目中谈到，你在很年轻的时候离开了一段虐待性质的恋爱关系。

sentences.en: And you said you had no self-esteem back then and that leaving the relationship sort of changed you on a cellular level,
sentences.zh: 当时你说自己那时毫无自尊，离开那段关系在某种程度上从细胞层面上改变了你，

sentences.en: the fact that you discovered that you were someone who could leave a situation like that.
sentences.zh: 因为你发现自己竟然是一个能够离开这种处境的人。

sentences.en: And I was wondering if you could just talk me through what that lack of confidence felt like because I guess looking at it, it didn't seem obvious.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能不能跟我聊聊那种缺乏自信的感觉是什么样的，因为从旁观者的角度来看，似乎并不明显。

sentences.en: Well, I think I was very good at being a professional and showing up and doing the right thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我很擅长做一个专业人士，按时出现并做正确的事情。

sentences.en: But I wasn't emotionally mature when I was young.
sentences.zh: 但我年轻时在情感上还不够成熟。

sentences.en: And you get in relationships that don't work for you.
sentences.zh: 你会陷入并不适合你的恋爱关系中。

sentences.en: And sometimes you don't even see the dynamics that are happening.
sentences.zh: 有时候你甚至看不到正在发生的那些有毒的动态关系。

sentences.en: So when I got out of that, it took me a while to reconstitute myself.
sentences.zh: 所以当我摆脱那段关系后，我花了很长时间才重塑自我。

sentences.en: My spirit had been diminished because I thought all those awful things that person said about me were true.
sentences.zh: 我的精神曾被极大地摧残，因为我以为那个人对我说过的那些可怕的话都是真的。

sentences.en: And I had to rewire my brain.
sentences.zh: 我不得不重新调整我的大脑。

sentences.en: But I was really insecure.
sentences.zh: 但我当时真的极度缺乏安全感。

sentences.en: Because I've talked to a lot of people who've been in abusive relationships and they can't see it.
sentences.zh: 因为我跟许多经历过虐待关系的人聊过，他们自己根本察觉不到。

sentences.en: And, you know, and I couldn't, I couldn't see it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我当时也察觉不到，我根本看不清。

sentences.en: It took me a long time to be this woman that I am now.
sentences.zh: 我花了很长时间才成为今天这样的女性。

sentences.en: When you say you had to reconstitute yourself, what does that look like when you're also having to sort of be a person out in the world?
sentences.zh: 当你觉得必须重塑自我时，对于一个同时还必须在公众面前抛头露面的人来说，这到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: It's very hard to be a public figure.
sentences.zh: 作为一个公众人物是非常艰难的。

sentences.en: So I have a lot of compassion for people who live public lives and maintain privacy.
sentences.zh: 所以我对那些过着公众生活却又能保持隐私的人抱有极大的同情。

sentences.en: It's nearly impossible at this point with everybody dehumanizing you in a certain way,
sentences.zh: 在当今这个时代，这几乎是不可能的，因为每个人都在某种程度上将你非人化，

sentences.en: like taking pictures of you like you're an animal in the zoo instead of a person with their children or having a private moment.
sentences.zh: 就像把你当成动物园里的动物一样对你拍照，而不是把你当成一个带着孩子或者正享受私人时刻的普通人。

sentences.en: It was hard.
sentences.zh: 那段日子很难熬。

sentences.en: It was really hard.
sentences.zh: 真的非常难。

sentences.en: And being a mom, being a mom and wanting to protect young people is hard too, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且作为一个母亲，作为一个想要保护年轻人的母亲，也是同样艰难的，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I wanted to actually come to what happened after this because you end up in these big films that had a lot of initial success.
sentences.zh: 对，我其实想聊聊这之后发生的事，因为你后来接拍了那些一开始就获得巨大成功的重磅电影。

sentences.en: You just mentioned them, election, cruel intentions.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚提到了它们，《选举风暴》、《危险性游戏》。

sentences.en: And you end up getting married and having children.
sentences.zh: 然后你结婚并有了孩子。

sentences.en: Ryan Phillippe, of course, was your husband back then.
sentences.zh: 瑞恩·菲利普当时当然就是你的丈夫。

sentences.en: You had two children with him.
sentences.zh: 你为他生了两个孩子。

sentences.en: Great pronunciation.
sentences.zh: 发音真标准。

sentences.en: I had to look it up.
sentences.zh: 我特意查了一下。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: What was it about having kids?
sentences.zh: 拥有孩子是一种什么样的体验？

sentences.en: Because it was unusual, I think, in Hollywood to have kids, you know, in your early 20s.
sentences.zh: 因为在好莱坞，你知道的，在二十岁出头时就有孩子，这在当时并不多见。

sentences.en: Yeah, you think.
sentences.zh: 是的，你觉得呢。

sentences.en: There's parts of it that are private and personal that I don't really want to talk about.
sentences.zh: 其中有些部分是私密和个人的，我其实并不想谈论。

sentences.en: But I will talk about having kids at a young age.
sentences.zh: 但我愿意谈谈在年轻时生养孩子这件事。

sentences.en: There was so much I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 当时有太多事情是我不知道的。

sentences.en: And maybe that naivete was good.
sentences.zh: 也许那种天真反而是件好事。

sentences.en: Because I was like, oh, well, I'll just do that and have a career.
sentences.zh: 因为当时我想，噢，好吧，我把孩子生了就是，同时还能继续搞我的事业。

sentences.en: And I did have a few people say to me, this is going to be really hard on your career.
sentences.zh: 确实也有少数人对我说过，这会对你的事业造成沉重的打击。

sentences.en: And my mother was a pediatric nurse.
sentences.zh: 我母亲是一名儿科护士。

sentences.en: And she said, I'm going to help you.
sentences.zh: 她说，我会帮你。

sentences.en: But that was hard because she lived in Nashville and I lived in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 但这很难，因为她住在纳什维尔，而我住在洛杉矶。

sentences.en: So I went through everything that new moms go through, where it's sleepless nights and long days,
sentences.zh: 所以我经历了所有新手妈妈都会经历的事情，比如不眠之夜和漫长的白天，

sentences.en: endless bottle feedings and breastfeeding and trying to learn lines and go to do auditions, but organized childcare.
sentences.zh: 没完没了地喂奶、哺乳，还要努力背台词、去试镜，同时还要安排好育儿帮手。

sentences.en: And when I had my daughter, I didn't have nannies or help or anything.
sentences.zh: 当我生下女儿时，我没有保姆、没有任何帮手，也没有任何人支援。

sentences.en: I had somebody who would come watch her three hours twice a week.
sentences.zh: 我只有一个每周来帮我照看她两次、每次三个小时的人。

sentences.en: It was really hard.
sentences.zh: 那段日子真的太难了。

sentences.en: There were roles I couldn't take.
sentences.zh: 有很多角色我都无法接演。

sentences.en: I wasn't just in service of my career.
sentences.zh: 我不只是单纯为了自己的事业而活着。

sentences.en: I had to sort of have this immediate balance of family and career, being a mom and being a working actress.
sentences.zh: 我必须立刻在家庭和事业之间找到平衡，既要当一个好妈妈，又要当一个努力工作的女演员。

sentences.en: That's why it was also scary when Legally Blonde became such a big hit.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，当《律政俏佳人》获得巨大成功时，我也感到非常害怕。

sentences.en: I wasn't going to beg for parts.
sentences.zh: 我不会去低声下气地求角色。

sentences.en: Parts were coming to me.
sentences.zh: 角色主动找上了门。

sentences.en: And that almost made it scarier because I wasn't picking and choosing what I would reach and strive for.
sentences.zh: 而这反而让我更加害怕，因为我不再是去挑选和争取那些我想努力企及的东西了。

sentences.en: It was more like, what will I not do?
sentences.zh: 情况更变成了：我到底有哪些是不去做的？

sentences.en: And so I had to put boundaries in at a very young age.
sentences.zh: 所以我在很年轻的时候就必须设立好界限。

sentences.en: It was really hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难。

sentences.en: But I figured it out.
sentences.zh: 但我最终还是挺过来了。

sentences.en: I figured it out.
sentences.zh: 我总算把它给理顺了。

sentences.en: I kept on thinking about that while I was sort of reflecting on this moment for you, that, you know, you were this,
sentences.zh: 当我回想起你人生中的这个时刻时，我一直在想，你知道的，你当时正处于，

sentences.en: at the height of your success with Legally Blonde and this string of successes, and yet you were married and had kids and all your actress peers, that was not their reality.
sentences.zh: 凭借《律政俏佳人》和这一连串的成功达到了事业的巅峰，然而你却结了婚还有了孩子，你身边的女演员同行们，现实可完全不是这样的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Was it difficult to be in a different part of life than perhaps your peers were?
sentences.zh: 相比于同行们，身处不同的人生阶段，这会让你觉得困难吗？

sentences.en: You know what the most ironic part was?
sentences.zh: 你知道最具有讽刺意味的部分是什么吗？

sentences.en: I was always being told by different people in the industry, don't play a mom.
sentences.zh: 业界的不同人士总是对我说：千万别演母亲的角色。

sentences.en: It'll make you seem old.
sentences.zh: 那会让你显得老态。

sentences.en: And I was like, but I am a mom.
sentences.zh: 而我当时的心态是：可我本来就是个当妈的呀。

sentences.en: I was like, but, hmm.
sentences.zh: 我想的是，但是，呃……

sentences.en: I do think we've lost a lot of storytelling around mothers because there was so much about our business that it desexualized you.
sentences.zh: 我的确认为我们已经失去了很多围绕母亲展开的故事叙述，因为我们的行业有太多地方会剥夺你的性感。

sentences.en: So you couldn't be a movie star if you played a mom.
sentences.zh: 所以只要你演了母亲，你就再也当不成电影明星了。

sentences.en: And thank goodness that's sort of going by the wayside.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，这种观念现在正在逐渐被淘汰。

sentences.en: But that was a big part of when I was in my 20s and 30s, don't play a mom.
sentences.zh: 但在我二十多岁和三十多岁的时候，这绝对是个核心准则：千万别演妈妈。

sentences.en: No men will desire you or nobody will want to go see that movie because nobody wants to see a movie about a mom.
sentences.zh: 没有男人会渴望你，也没有人会想去看那部电影，因为根本没人想看关于妈妈的电影。

sentences.en: Were there people that you could turn to to kind of help you with that balance that you were trying to achieve?
sentences.zh: 当时有没有什么人可以让你去倾诉，帮你去平衡那些你想要做的事？

sentences.en: Well, I think as I got a little bit older, Jennifer Aniston was really helpful for me navigating personal life and tabloid curiosity and also shutting out all the noise.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得随着年龄稍微长了一些，詹妮弗·安妮斯顿对我的帮助真的很大，她帮我应对私生活和小报的好奇心，还能帮我屏蔽掉那些杂音。

sentences.en: You played her sister, obviously, in Friends.
sentences.zh: 显然，你在《老友记》里演过她的妹妹。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And you're in the morning show with her now.
sentences.zh: 你现在又和她一起出演《早间新闻》。

sentences.en: We played sisters on Friends and her and Courtney.
sentences.zh: 我们在《老友记》里演过姐妹，还有她和柯特妮。

sentences.en: I remember I brought my baby, Ava.
sentences.zh: 我记得我把我的宝贝女儿艾娃带来了。

sentences.en: Ava was only three months old when I was on Friends in 1999.
sentences.zh: 1999年我拍《老友记》的时候，艾娃才三个月大。

sentences.en: And I remember Courtney and Jen coming to my dressing room door and knocking on the door and going, we heard you have a baby.
sentences.zh: 我记得柯特妮和珍走到我的化妆室门口，敲了敲门说，听说你生了个宝宝。

sentences.en: I was like, I do.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的。

sentences.en: I have a baby.
sentences.zh: 我有个宝宝。

sentences.en: And they were like, can we see it?
sentences.zh: 她们就说，我们可以看看吗？

sentences.en: I was like, yes, she's right there.
sentences.zh: 我说，行啊，她就在那儿。

sentences.en: And they're like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 她们就说，哦，天哪。

sentences.en: This is so cool.
sentences.zh: 这也太可爱了吧。

sentences.en: And I just remember them being so kind about it.
sentences.zh: 我只记得她们当时人真的超级好。

sentences.en: And that kindness opened a door for me to ask Jennifer a lot of questions when I went through breakups or really public divorce.
sentences.zh: 而正是这种善意为我打开了一扇门，每当我经历分手或闹得沸沸扬扬的离婚时，我都可以去向詹妮弗请教很多问题。

sentences.en: And she was just really always very generous with advice and care.
sentences.zh: 而且她总是非常慷慨地给予我建议和关怀。

sentences.en: What advice was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的建议？

sentences.en: I mean, what are the lessons of having to protect yourself, essentially?
sentences.zh: 我是说，本质上保护自己有哪些经验教训？

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: There's just hundreds of them.
sentences.zh: 有成百上千条呢。

sentences.en: Well, actually, Jennifer Garner and I, too, are very close.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实，詹妮弗·加纳和我关系也非常好。

sentences.en: And we would talk a lot about navigating public interest in our kids and how we could protect them from pictures and paparazzi.
sentences.zh: 我们会经常探讨如何应对公众对我们孩子的关注，以及我们该如何保护他们免受照片和狗仔队的骚扰。

sentences.en: Because they would be everywhere, all over the schools and all over the cars.
sentences.zh: 因为他们无处不在，学校周围到处都是，车子周围也到处都是。

sentences.en: There was always this surprise, somebody jumping out of the bushes.
sentences.zh: 总会有这种突发情况，有人突然从灌木丛里跳出来。

sentences.en: Or I remember at church once in L.A., a guy jumping on the hood of the car.
sentences.zh: 或者我记得在洛杉矶的一次礼拜时，有个家伙直接跳到了车前盖上。

sentences.en: And on each side, three people pushing against the window, banging on the door when my kids were little after I got a divorce.
sentences.zh: 我离婚后有一次，在孩子们还小的时候，车窗两边各挤着三个人拼命拍打车窗，猛砸车门。

sentences.en: And chasing us like it was a police chase down the freeways.
sentences.zh: 还像警察追捕犯人一样在高速公路上对我们穷追不舍。

sentences.en: It was terrifying.
sentences.zh: 那太吓人了。

sentences.en: And the fact that we survived that.
sentences.zh: 一想到我们竟然挺过来了。

sentences.en: But I do think it was really hard on my kids.
sentences.zh: 但我确实觉得这对我的孩子伤害很大。

sentences.en: It was really hard.
sentences.zh: 真的伤害很大。

sentences.en: Anxiety producing.
sentences.zh: 太容易让人产生焦虑了。

sentences.en: And I really, I regret living in L.A.
sentences.zh: 我真的很后悔住在洛杉矶

sentences.en: during that time.
sentences.zh: 在那段时期。

sentences.en: It was too hard on the kids.
sentences.zh: 这对孩子们来说太痛苦了。

sentences.en: And I know it feels like they're just taking pictures.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来好像他们只是在拍照。

sentences.en: But it would be like 25 people on the side of the soccer field photographing me and Ryan to see if we got along or we didn't get along.
sentences.zh: 但当时的情况是，足球场边会有25个人围着我和瑞安拍照，想看看我们到底合不合得来。

sentences.en: And it was, and it was, there was a little boy and a little girl there.
sentences.zh: 而且当时，当时现场还有一个小男孩和一个小女孩。

sentences.en: And it just, yeah, I watched them chase Britney Spears and she had two little children.
sentences.zh: 然后我就，对，我看着他们追逐布兰妮·斯皮尔斯，她当时带着两个幼儿。

sentences.en: And I had two little children.
sentences.zh: 而我也带着两个幼儿。

sentences.en: And I felt like it was this really unfair portrayal of her as a bad girl.
sentences.zh: 我觉得媒体把她刻画成一个坏女孩，这非常不公平。

sentences.en: And, but I was a good girl.
sentences.zh: 而我呢，是个好女孩。

sentences.en: And she was a mother, a young mother trying to figure it out away from home, being chased like an animal.
sentences.zh: 她却是一位母亲，一个背井离乡、独自摸索的年轻母亲，却像动物一样被人追赶。

sentences.en: And what that kicks up inside your body and what it does for you is very traumatic.
sentences.zh: 这种经历在你的体内激起的情绪以及它对你造成的创伤是非常巨大的。

sentences.en: I just have incredible compassion for people that went through that time period and were portrayed a certain way by the media because of,
sentences.zh: 我对那些经历过那个时期、却因为媒体的种种 portrayal 而被塑造成某种特定形象的人

sentences.en: if they went to a nightclub versus they went to the playground, you know.
sentences.zh: 比如他们是去夜总会还是去游乐场，你知道的，我抱有无比深切的同情。

sentences.en: It was a very punishing time for women who were in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 对于处在聚光灯下的女性来说，那是一个非常残酷的时期。

sentences.en: How did you explain that to your kids and did you see like the effects of that for them?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么向孩子们解释这一切的？你有没有发现这给他们带来了一些影响？

sentences.en: Yes, my kids had anxiety, really bad anxiety.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的孩子们曾经有焦虑症，非常严重的焦虑症。

sentences.en: And it was all external.
sentences.zh: 而且全都是来自外部的影响。

sentences.en: It was, you can only shield them from so much, but when they can go to the playgrounds and on the schoolyard, it feels like the world is chaos and there are no rules.
sentences.zh: 就是说，你只能在一定程度上保护他们，但当他们去游乐场和学校操场时，会觉得这个世界充满了混乱，根本没有规则可言。

sentences.en: And there was like this invisible barrier.
sentences.zh: 而且当时有一种无形的屏障。

sentences.en: They would never touch your body, but they would scream.
sentences.zh: 他们虽然不会对你动粗，但会尖叫。

sentences.en: They would yell things at the kids about their dad or me that were wildly inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 他们会朝着孩子们大喊大叫，说一些关于他们的爸爸或我的、极其不合适的话。

sentences.en: At the children?
sentences.zh: 是对着孩子们？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People, these videos exiSt.
sentences.zh: 大家注意，这些视频都是真实存在的。

sentences.en: And then they would only show the one part where I was screaming back at them, going, get back in your cars.
sentences.zh: 然后他们却只剪辑我朝着他们大吼、让他们滚回车里去的那个画面。

sentences.en: Leave us alone.
sentences.zh: 离我们远点。

sentences.en: I'm not trying to garner sympathy.
sentences.zh: 我不是为了博取同情。

sentences.en: It was my life.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的生活。

sentences.en: I just, I didn't know that that was what would come with wanting to be an actor or storyteller at that level.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我当时并不知道成为那种级别的演员或讲故事的人会付出这样的代价。

sentences.en: That's why when social media emerged, Jennifer and I got on the phone and we're like, oh my God, we can create our own storytelling?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当社交媒体出现时，我和詹妮弗马上通了电话，我们当时想，哦天哪，我们可以自己创作内容了？

sentences.en: We can decide when people have pictures of our kids?
sentences.zh: 我们可以自己决定别人什么时候能拍到我们孩子的照片？

sentences.en: Sign me up.
sentences.zh: 算我一个。

sentences.en: You felt like this was a way for you to decide how much and when and in what way you were going to open the door.
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是一种让你能够自己决定在什么时候、以什么方式、敞开多少大门的方法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It devalued that market.
sentences.zh: 这让那个市场贬值了。

sentences.en: There was no longer a market to see pictures of my children because they were, people were getting it for free.
sentences.zh: 买我孩子照片的市场不复存在了，因为大家都可以免费得到了。

sentences.en: And also, it had great use.
sentences.zh: 而且，这也带来了巨大的用处。

sentences.en: I mean, what I felt like, oh, I immediately saw this opportunity to build community online.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当时我觉得，哦，我立刻看到了在网上建立社群的机会。

sentences.en: It only took me a couple of years and I ideated around this with Sarah Hardin, the CEO of Hello Sunshine.
sentences.zh: 我只花了几年时间，就和“阳光工作室”（Hello Sunshine）的首席执行官莎拉·哈登一起围绕这个构想了很久。

sentences.en: And she came on and I said, you know,
sentences.zh: 她加入后我说，你知道吗，

sentences.en: how do we take the book club out of your grandma's living room and into the digital world and create a community that's far-reaching and global?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么才能把读书俱乐部从你奶奶的客厅搬到数字世界里，打造一个影响深远、面向全球的社群呢？

sentences.en: And that, the people come up to me about two things.
sentences.zh: 结果呢，人们见到我总是会聊起两件事。

sentences.en: Legally Blonde, of course, you'd think that, right?
sentences.zh: 《律政俏佳人》，当然，你肯定能猜到，对吧？

sentences.en: And they like to say, what, like, it's hard and can I show you the bend and snap or can you do the bend and snap?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢说，什么，这很难吗？我可以给你展示一下“回眸一笑弯腰抓”（bend and snap）吗，或者你能做一下吗？

sentences.en: Did they actually ask you to do the bend and snap?
sentences.zh: 他们真的会要求你表演“回眸一笑弯腰抓”吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes I do the bend and snap.
sentences.zh: 有时我会做一下“回眸一笑弯腰抓”。

sentences.en: If you see me do the bend and snap, you're very lucky because I think I've only done it a handful of times.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到我做了这个动作，那你真的很幸运，因为我觉得我只当众做过寥寥几次。

sentences.en: I was about to say.
sentences.zh: 我正想这么说呢。

sentences.en: I'm not going to ask you.
sentences.zh: 我才不会要求你做呢。

sentences.en: Am I going to be like an 85-year-old lady sitting on a porch and like doing the bend and snap on Instagram?
sentences.zh: 难道我要像一个85岁的老太太一样坐在门廊上，在Instagram上做“回眸一笑弯腰抓”吗？

sentences.en: God, I hope not.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我希望不会。

sentences.en: There are worst things in the world.
sentences.zh: 这世上还有比这更糟糕的事呢。

sentences.en: If you can still do the bend and snap at 80, I think actually you're in a good place.
sentences.zh: 如果你到了80岁还能做“回眸一笑弯腰抓”，我觉得其实你的状态相当不错。

sentences.en: I might come out with a bend and snap workout.
sentences.zh: 说不定我会推出一个“回眸一笑弯腰抓”健身操呢。

sentences.en: It could be a whole new business model.
sentences.zh: 这可能会成为一个全新的商业模式。

sentences.en: No, that, people come up to me and ask me about Legally Blonde.
sentences.zh: 不是的，人们来找我都是问关于《律政俏佳人》的事。

sentences.en: And then the other thing is the book club.
sentences.zh: 然后另一件事就是读书俱乐部。

sentences.en: What's so interesting about you becoming the businesswoman that you are today is that preceding that moment, you were kind of in a professionally fallow period.
sentences.zh: 你今天能成为这样一个女商人，最有趣的地方在于，在此之前，你其实经历了一段职业上的低谷期。

sentences.en: You'd won an Oscar.
sentences.zh: 你赢过奥斯卡。

sentences.en: You had, you know, kind of gone through all the heights that you can in a career.
sentences.zh: 你经历过，你知道的，可以说是职业生涯里所有的高光时刻。

sentences.en: But you stopped for a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但你停滞了一小段时间。

sentences.en: And I wonder what that fallow period where you weren't creatively getting to do the things that you wanted to do, what that was like for you?
sentences.zh: 我在想，那段无法按自己的意愿进行艺术创作的低谷期，对你来说是怎么样的？

sentences.en: What did you learn about yourself in that period?
sentences.zh: 在那段时期里，你对自己有了什么认识？

sentences.en: Well, I learned that in order to be successful in any business, you have to understand every aspect of it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我懂得了要想在任何行业取得成功，你必须了解这个行业的方方面面。

sentences.en: And it forced me to get more macro about it, back up and understand the business better,
sentences.zh: 这逼着我从宏观上去看待问题，退后一步更好地理解整个商业运作，

sentences.en: and why they're not making more movies that I want to be in or more movies that I would let my daughter watch.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么他们不再拍更多我想演的电影，或者更多我会让我女儿看的电影。

sentences.en: And so it forced me to get analytical.
sentences.zh: 所以它逼着我变得更有分析能力。

sentences.en: And it started as a company called Pacific Standard, and that came from two years of just ideating and going,
sentences.zh: 它最初是一家名为“太平洋标准”（Pacific Standard）的公司，这是经过两年构思后诞生的，当时我就在想，

sentences.en: there's a missing lane here of developing film that has a woman at the center of it.
sentences.zh: 这里缺少一种以女性为核心的电影开发方向。

sentences.en: And then I was like, okay, well, what if it's books, too?
sentences.zh: 然后我就想，好吧，那如果是书呢？

sentences.en: And then the two came together where it was like, oh, okay, I should option some books to make them into movies.
sentences.zh: 接着这两者结合在了一起，就像是，哦，好吧，我应该买下一些书的版权把它们拍成电影。

sentences.en: And then it just grew because Instagram came around, and I was like, oh, let's build an online community.
sentences.zh: 然后它就不断发展壮大，因为Instagram出现了，我就想，哦，让我们建立一个在线社群吧。

sentences.en: And then I think the part of my brain that gets really turned on is how you connect community, the IP, and all the social relationships.
sentences.zh: 然后我觉得我大脑中最被激活的部分，是如何将社群、知识产权（IP）以及所有的社交关系连接起来。

sentences.en: So I had all these friendships from working for 20 years in the movie business with other actors and actresses and filmmakers, and how I put that to work.
sentences.zh: 我在电影行业工作了20年，和许多男演员、女演员以及电影人建立了各种友谊，我一直在想怎么把这些资源利用起来。

sentences.en: And so when those three things started coming together, as media was changing, I was there to meet the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以，当这三件事随着媒体的变革开始融合时，我正好迎合了时代的契机。

sentences.en: I already had IP, and I had options, and I had books, and I had filmmakers.
sentences.zh: 我当时已经有了IP，也有了版权选项，有了书籍，还有电影人。

sentences.en: I had it ready to go for when streaming emerged and they needed content.
sentences.zh: 当流媒体崛起并且需要内容时，我都已经准备就绪了。

sentences.en: I had the content to provide.
sentences.zh: 我有现成的内容可以提供。

sentences.en: It also took that shiny part of fame that was so difficult to deal with, and I got to pivot that light onto people who I felt like were very deserving.
sentences.zh: 这也让我得以从名气中剥离出那些耀眼却难以应对的部分，把聚光灯转向那些我认为非常值得关注的人。

sentences.en: And I could stand next to them and promote their book.
sentences.zh: 我可以站在他们身边，为他们的书做宣传。

sentences.en: And it was like, oh, this is such a great use of fame.
sentences.zh: 当时我就觉得，哦，这简直是对名气最好的利用。

sentences.en: I mean, it brings me back to something you said earlier, which was that first moment when someone said to you, you are a leader, you can lead.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了你之前说过的一句话，那就是当有人第一次对你说“你是一个领袖，你能带头”的那一刻。

sentences.en: This seemed like a natural evolution to what you had kind of been working on.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是你一直在做的事情的自然演变。

sentences.en: I'm really frustrated and angry in my existing career to hit the wall, to want to take on a new aspect.
sentences.zh: 我在现有的职业生涯中碰壁时感到非常沮丧和愤怒，想要涉足一个新的领域。

sentences.en: It's an entirely different career.
sentences.zh: 这是一份完全不同的事业。

sentences.en: It's two totally different careers.
sentences.zh: 这是两份截然不同的事业。

sentences.en: Explain that to me.
sentences.zh: 给我解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: And I jostle between the two of them at all times, being a creator and being a person who understands the economics of creating.
sentences.zh: 我始终在创作者和理解创作经济学的人这两种身份之间左右权衡、来回切换。

sentences.en: But the part about understanding the shifting economics of the entertainment industry, that's fun for me now.
sentences.zh: 但理解娱乐产业不断变化的经济学这一部分，现在对我来说很有趣。

sentences.en: Fun?
sentences.zh: 有趣？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It actually is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I find it really fun.
sentences.zh: 我发现这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: I like to forecast about it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢对它进行预测。

sentences.en: I'm not always right, but I listen to other people's forecasting.
sentences.zh: 我并不总是对的，但我会听取别人的预测。

sentences.en: I watch it.
sentences.zh: 我会关注这些。

sentences.en: I write people who I think have a really good take on our business.
sentences.zh: 我会写信给那些我认为对我们的行业有独到见解的人。

sentences.en: And I've been inside it since I was 14 years old.
sentences.zh: 我从14岁起就在这个行业里了。

sentences.en: I have a very clear-eyed opinion of it.
sentences.zh: 我对它有着非常清醒的看法。

sentences.en: I'm not starry-eyed about any of it.
sentences.zh: 我对这一切都不抱任何不切实际的幻想。

sentences.en: And you have to be pragmatic when you have a company like mine, because time is your biggest asset.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有一家像我这样的公司时，你必须务实，因为时间是你最大的资产。

sentences.en: You can't waste time on things you can't get made.
sentences.zh: 你不能把时间浪费在那些无法付诸实践的事情上。

sentences.en: So you have to be very, very thoughtful about what projects you take on, what books we option, and then you have to throw all your energy at it.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须非常、非常深思熟虑地考虑你要接手哪些项目，我们该买下哪些书的版权，然后你必须把所有的精力都投入进去。

sentences.en: So if it doesn't work at any point, you have to be very comfortable with cutting bait and moving on.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果它在任何阶段行不通，你就必须能够坦然地及时止损并继续前行。

sentences.en: I mean, you're starting a business project focused on Gen Z women.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你正在创办一个聚焦Z世代女性的商业项目。

sentences.en: Your kids are Gen Z.
sentences.zh: 你的孩子就是Z世代。

sentences.en: When you're looking and you're forecasting, what are you seeing?
sentences.zh: 当你观察并进行预测时，你看到了什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I would love to know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我很想知道。

sentences.en: Well, this is part of the great thing about being a young mom is my kids tell me everything that's going on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，作为一个年轻妈妈的一大好处就在于，我的孩子们会把发生的一切都告诉我。

sentences.en: And so that helps me forecast what's happening in the media world, because they tell me firSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这帮我预测媒体世界正在发生什么，因为他们总是第一时间告诉我。

sentences.en: I noticed my kids weren't going to the movies.
sentences.zh: 我注意到我的孩子们不怎么去电影院看电影了。

sentences.en: I had teenage kids.
sentences.zh: 我有正处于青少年时期的孩子。

sentences.en: I went to the movies every Friday and Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 我当年可是每周五和周六晚上都要去电影院的。

sentences.en: Kids don't go to the movies.
sentences.zh: 现在的孩子们不去电影院了。

sentences.en: Usually people are seeing one movie a year in the theaters with their kids.
sentences.zh: 通常人们一年到头也就是带孩子去电影院看一部电影。

sentences.en: So you got to go where the audience is, not lament the fact that they didn't show up.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须去观众在的地方，而不是去哀叹他们没有出现。

sentences.en: Or have what I call old school-itis, which is like, well, in my day, well, it just doesn't work that way.
sentences.zh: 或者有我所谓的“老派综合征”，就像是，“唉，在我的时代……”，这行不通。

sentences.en: You got to go to where the audience is.
sentences.zh: 你必须去观众所在的地方。

sentences.en: But we're, you know, attention spans are shifting.
sentences.zh: 但我们的，你知道的，注意力持续时间正在改变。

sentences.en: They just are.
sentences.zh: 事实就是这样。

sentences.en: The way we make movies is going to change radically in the next two years to three years.
sentences.zh: 我们在未来两到三年内制作电影的方式将会发生根本性的变化。

sentences.en: Because of AI.
sentences.zh: 因为人工智能。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Everybody knows it.
sentences.zh: 所有人都知道这一点。

sentences.en: It's like you just have to understand how it's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 就像你必须明白这一切将如何发生一样。

sentences.en: Because we still have to layer our consciousness on top of it and use it as tools.
sentences.zh: 因为我们仍然必须将我们的意识叠加在它之上，并把它作为工具。

sentences.en: Because otherwise, it's just a runaway train.
sentences.zh: 否则，它就像是一辆失控的列车。

sentences.en: And it can't make you laugh.
sentences.zh: 而且它无法让你笑。

sentences.en: AI has never made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 人工智能从未让我笑过。

sentences.en: Not once.
sentences.zh: 一次也没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I did a whole AI thing with Will Ferrell when we were standing on set of your course,
sentences.zh: 我和威尔·法瑞尔（Will Ferrell）一起做过一个关于人工智能的完整东西，当时我们正站在你们片场的布景上，

sentences.en: and our director, Nick Stoller, put in, come up with movie ideas for Will Ferrell and Reese Witherspoon in a romantic comedy.
sentences.zh: 我们的导演尼克·斯托勒（Nick Stoller）输入了“为威尔·法瑞尔和瑞茜·威瑟斯彭想一些浪漫喜剧的电影创意”。

sentences.en: And it spit out like 10.
sentences.zh: 然后它吐出了大约10个。

sentences.en: And three of them were actually not too bad.
sentences.zh: 其中3个其实还算不错。

sentences.en: Will came up with 10 other ones that were so much better.
sentences.zh: 威尔想出了另外10个好得多的。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Well, talking about the industry, there's this moment that you talked about after Big Little Lies comes out on HBO in 2017, which you starred in.
sentences.zh: 好吧，说到这个行业，你在2017年HBO推出《大小谎言》之后谈到了这样一个时刻，你也是主演之一。

sentences.en: It was this huge hit in terms of awards, in terms of just public reaction.
sentences.zh: 无论是在奖项方面，还是在公众反应方面，它都取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: But you said that the project barely broke even.
sentences.zh: 但你说过这个项目几乎没有收支持平。

sentences.en: For my company.
sentences.zh: 对我的公司来说。

sentences.en: For your company, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对你的公司来说，是的。

sentences.en: My producing fees.
sentences.zh: 靠我的制作费。

sentences.en: That's what I mean.
sentences.zh: 我是说这个。

sentences.en: And I just want to understand, like, what are the mechanics of that?
sentences.zh: 我只是想了解，这背后的运作机制是什么？

sentences.en: When we're looking at the industry and where it's at and what it takes to make quality work, why didn't that work out?
sentences.zh: 当我们审视这个行业、它所处的位置以及创作高质量作品所需的条件时，为什么那个项目没有成功？

sentences.en: And what did you learn from that?
sentences.zh: 你从中学到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I had set up my company fundamentally in a way that it could never be profitable because I was just working off producing fees.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我最初建立公司的基础方式决定了它永远不可能盈利，因为我只是靠制作费勉强维持。

sentences.en: It's too inside baseball and a little bit boring.
sentences.zh: 这有点太圈内话了，也有点无聊。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm interested.
sentences.zh: 我很感兴趣。

sentences.en: I had set up the company and we had so much success with Gone Girl, Wild, Big Little Lies.
sentences.zh: 我创立了这家公司，我们在《消失的爱人》、《走出荒野》、《大小谎言》上取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: And that was a big financial success for HBO.
sentences.zh: 这对HBO来说是一个巨大的财务成功。

sentences.en: But it wasn't for my production company because I was trying to keep five women employed with great health insurance in, you know, an office building.
sentences.zh: 但对我的制作公司来说却不是，因为我试图让五名女性在办公大楼里有工作、有很好的健康保险，你知道的。

sentences.en: And we didn't know where our next producing job was going to come from.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道我们的下一份制作工作在哪里。

sentences.en: I was like, this isn't a sustainable business model.
sentences.zh: 我就觉得，这不是一个可持续的商业模式。

sentences.en: I need more predictable revenue.
sentences.zh: 我需要更可预测的收入。

sentences.en: And that's when I got business partners, backed up and built a business plan.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我找到了商业合伙人，退后一步制定了商业计划。

sentences.en: And I raised capital from AT&T and Lorene Powell Jobs through Emerson Collective.
sentences.zh: 我通过爱默生集体（Emerson Collective）从AT&T和劳伦·鲍威尔·乔布斯（Lorene Powell Jobs）那里筹集了资金。

sentences.en: And we only raised one Series A.
sentences.zh: 我们只进行了一轮A轮融资。

sentences.en: And then we sold in 2021.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在2021年将其出售。

sentences.en: That was a big payday.
sentences.zh: 那是一笔巨大的收入。

sentences.en: You were acquired by Candle Media for almost a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 你被烛光传媒（Candle Media）以近十亿美元的价格收购了。

sentences.en: What was that like that day?
sentences.zh: 那天感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Very emotional.
sentences.zh: 非常情绪化。

sentences.en: And it was a big deal for me because I had really held out during those negotiations with different entities that wanted to buy the company.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说是一件大事，因为在与那些想要收购公司的不同实体进行谈判时，我真的坚持了很久。

sentences.en: And I'd waited for the best valuation of the company because so many women had equity in the company.
sentences.zh: 我一直在等待公司最好的估值，因为有那么多的女性在公司里拥有股权。

sentences.en: And it was really important to me that these women, who a lot of them gave up corporate jobs, to follow my dreams and my vision and help me execute.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，最重要的是这些女性——她们中的许多人放弃了企业的工作来追随我的梦想和愿景并帮助我执行——

sentences.en: And they all got paid.
sentences.zh: 她们都得到了回报。

sentences.en: And that was a big deal for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说是一件大事。

sentences.en: Because I also thought, I got to be really careful who this sells to and what the value is.
sentences.zh: 因为我也在想，我必须非常小心要把公司卖给谁以及它的价值是多少。

sentences.en: Because it's putting value on women's storytelling.
sentences.zh: 因为这是在给女性讲故事赋予价值。

sentences.en: And what are we saying to the world?
sentences.zh: 我们在向世界表达什么？

sentences.en: And I was like, oh.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，哦。

sentences.en: And I also thought about my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 我也想到了我的祖母。

sentences.en: Who loved stories and had – she went to Vanderbilt University and had a degree, a teaching degree.
sentences.zh: 她热爱故事，而且她曾就读于范德堡大学，拥有学位，一个教学学位。

sentences.en: And she just couldn't really do anything with it.
sentences.zh: 但她真的无法用它做什么。

sentences.en: And I could tell she was a frustrated intellectual.
sentences.zh: 我能看出她是一个受挫的知识分子。

sentences.en: And that she didn't want to teach first grade.
sentences.zh: 她并不想教一年级。

sentences.en: She loved first grade.
sentences.zh: 她热爱一年级。

sentences.en: But she wanted to write books.
sentences.zh: 但她想写书。

sentences.en: And she wanted to travel the world.
sentences.zh: 她想环游世界。

sentences.en: And she didn't get to do that.
sentences.zh: 而她没有机会做到这一点。

sentences.en: And so I thought, I'm living my grandmother's dream.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，我正在实现我祖母的梦想。

sentences.en: What did you do to celebrate?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么来庆祝？

sentences.en: I remember getting on – it was COVID.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时正值——那是疫情期间。

sentences.en: So we were all in lockdown.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都在隔离封锁中。

sentences.en: And I'd get on a Zoom with everybody in Hello Sunshine.
sentences.zh: 我会和Hello Sunshine的所有人开Zoom会议。

sentences.en: And I thought really long about what song I would play before we went on and told everybody.
sentences.zh: 在上线告诉大家之前，我花了好长时间思考我要播放什么歌曲。

sentences.en: And I played Here Comes the Sun by The Beatles.
sentences.zh: 我播放了披头士乐队的《Here Comes the Sun》。

sentences.en: It makes me want to cry.
sentences.zh: 这让我想哭。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Because it was like a hopeful moment that people actually cared about women's stories.
sentences.zh: 因为这就像是一个充满希望的时刻，人们真的关心女性的故事。

sentences.en: Like, we weren't in the margins anymore.
sentences.zh: 就像我们不再处于边缘地位一样。

sentences.en: We were the main story.
sentences.zh: 我们成了主要的故事。

sentences.en: And it made me think, okay, if I can do this, I want to make sure other women can do it who are coming up after me.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得，好吧，如果我能做到这一点，我想确保其他在我之后崛起的女性也能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Because if I fail here, this is going to tell every little girl who has a dream of being a producer or a director that she's not going to make it.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我在这里失败了，这将告诉每一个怀揣制作人或导演梦想的小女孩，她不会成功的。

sentences.en: So I pressured myself a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以我给自己施加了很大的压力。

sentences.en: But it was a great day.
sentences.zh: 但那真是美好的一天。

sentences.en: It was a great day.
sentences.zh: 那真是美好的一天。

sentences.en: I think one of the other things that it did is show that there's a market for it, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为它所做的另一件事是表明这里存在一个市场，对吧？

sentences.en: That you can make these kinds of stories and they can make money.
sentences.zh: 你可以创作这类故事，而且它们能赚钱。

sentences.en: Because, you know, not everyone's into it just for the higher purpose.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，并非每个人都仅仅为了崇高的目标而参与其中。

sentences.en: No, it's a business.
sentences.zh: 不，这是一笔生意。

sentences.en: It's the movie business.
sentences.zh: 这是电影生意。

sentences.en: It has to make money.
sentences.zh: 它必须赚钱。

sentences.en: It has to justify the coSt.
sentences.zh: 它必须证明成本的合理性。

sentences.en: I understand that.
sentences.zh: 我理解这一点。

sentences.en: And so when I was able to blend my ideology with that business model and it became successful, I felt like, wow,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我能够将我的意识形态与这种商业模式融合并取得成功时，我感觉，哇，

sentences.en: I think I've aligned for what I was meant to do here in this lifetime.
sentences.zh: 我想我已经实现了我在这世上一生注定要做的事。

sentences.en: The CEO of Candle Media recently did an interview with Semaphore.
sentences.zh: 烛光传媒（Candle Media）的首席执行官最近接受了Semaphore的采访。

sentences.en: And he said that you've been a great partner, but he also said that Hello Sunshine, quote, wasn't worth what we paid.
sentences.zh: 他说你一直是个很棒的合作伙伴，但他也说Hello Sunshine“不值我们支付的价格”。

sentences.en: How does that sit with you?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's short-sighted, being honeSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，老实说，我认为这很短视。

sentences.en: He and I have talked about it.
sentences.zh: 我和他谈过这件事。

sentences.en: I'm all about full candor and discussions.
sentences.zh: 我一向主张完全坦诚和讨论。

sentences.en: I think the world is shifting.
sentences.zh: 我认为世界正在改变。

sentences.en: And just because one aspect of our company didn't hit the numbers a certain year that anybody thought it was going to hit, that doesn't mean it's not valuable.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为我们公司的一个方面在某一年没有达到任何人认为它会达到的数字，并不意味着它没有价值。

sentences.en: And I think, gosh, don't try to bury something that's a seed.
sentences.zh: 我想，天哪，不要试图掩埋一颗种子。

sentences.en: It's going to grow and grow and grow because it's a wonderful brand and it stands for something.
sentences.zh: 它会不断生长、生长、再生长，因为它是一个伟大的品牌，它代表着某种东西。

sentences.en: It means something.
sentences.zh: 它有意义。

sentences.en: I mean, I do think it speaks to the sort of changing media landscape because in that interview, he talks about how the goal now with, quote, traditional media.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我确实认为这反映了某种不断变化的媒体格局，因为在采访中，他谈到了现在所谓“传统媒体”的目标。

sentences.en: So I guess he's talking about a TV show is to, quote, retell and to extend those stories on social media.
sentences.zh: 所以我想他指的是电视剧，其目标是“重述并在社交媒体上延伸这些故事”。

sentences.en: And he added that the goal hadn't worked out as well as he expected.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，这个目标并没有像他预期那样发挥作用。

sentences.en: I did not understand what he meant.
sentences.zh: 我当时不明白他的意思。

sentences.en: And maybe that's me.
sentences.zh: 也许这是我的问题。

sentences.en: But I...
sentences.zh: 但我……

sentences.en: Yeah, we can ask.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们可以问问。

sentences.en: If you want to call him.
sentences.zh: 如果你想给他打电话的话。

sentences.en: But do you understand what he means?
sentences.zh: 但你明白他的意思吗？

sentences.en: I mean, can you explain what the goal is now?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你能解释一下现在的目标是什么吗？

sentences.en: I can't explain what he was trying to say because I don't know, right?
sentences.zh: 我无法解释他试图表达什么，因为我不知道，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't live inside his head.
sentences.zh: 我没有住在他脑子里。

sentences.en: But what I think you got to look at more macro is the predictable revenue structures.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你必须从宏观上去看可预测的收入结构。

sentences.en: So we have a very successful conference every year that is all about leading with experts in different areas of women's interests.
sentences.zh: 所以我们每年都有一个非常成功的会议，全部都是关于由女性兴趣不同领域的专家带头。

sentences.en: You know, from health and wellness to entrepreneurship to banking to storytelling.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，从健康与保健到创业、银行再到讲故事。

sentences.en: That's been really successful.
sentences.zh: 那非常成功。

sentences.en: So we have live events.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有现场活动。

sentences.en: We have brand partnerships.
sentences.zh: 我们有品牌合作。

sentences.en: We have the book club.
sentences.zh: 我们有读书俱乐部。

sentences.en: And then we have scripted.
sentences.zh: 然后我们有剧本影视。

sentences.en: And then we have unscripted.
sentences.zh: 然后我们有无剧本节目。

sentences.en: So there's so many different components.
sentences.zh: 所以有这么多不同的组成部分。

sentences.en: If one component isn't working, you don't just say the whole thing isn't working.
sentences.zh: 如果其中一个部分没有起作用，你不能直接说整个事情都没有起作用。

sentences.en: Like, you pivot.
sentences.zh: 就像，你要调整。

sentences.en: You pivot your business model.
sentences.zh: 你要调整你的商业模式。

sentences.en: And we're looking at all of that now, right, and going, how can we grow more to where the audience is?
sentences.zh: 我们现在正在审视所有这些，对吧，并思考，我们怎样才能更多地成长到观众所在的地方？

sentences.en: But it's shifting, you know, and that's, we're lucky enough to be able to shift, right?
sentences.zh: 但它在不断变化，你知道的，而且，我们很幸运能够进行调整，对吧？

sentences.en: We're not some big behemoth media company.
sentences.zh: 我们不是什么庞大的巨无霸媒体公司。

sentences.en: We can have a new business plan and be able to move and shape and grow with culture.
sentences.zh: 我们可以拥有一个新的商业计划，并能够与文化一起移动、塑造和成长。

sentences.en: After the break, I talked to Reese again, and she has more to say about motherhood.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我再次与瑞茜交谈，她对为人父母有更多要说的。

sentences.en: I'm so tired.
sentences.zh: 我太累了。

sentences.en: I've been, I've been parenting for 25 years.
sentences.zh: 我一直在，我当了25年的父母。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘（Wynna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏部门的字谜游戏Connections。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天创作拼字游戏Spelling Bee和Letterboxd。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“色听”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚刚听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com slash games今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: Hi, nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Hi, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 嗨，露露。

sentences.en: We covered so much ground in our last conversation.
sentences.zh: 我们在上一次对话中聊了非常多的内容。

sentences.en: I was wondering if there was anything on your mind from our last talk.
sentences.zh: 我想知道关于上次的谈话，你心里有没有什么感触。

sentences.en: We talked about things I don't, I don't normally talk about.
sentences.zh: 我们聊到了一些我平时不会去谈论的事情。

sentences.en: So I felt like, you know, I was kind of reflecting on people.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉，你知道，我当时有点在反思关于人的事情。

sentences.en: There used to be this sort of feeling of you're not supposed to ask.
sentences.zh: 过去总有一种感觉，就是有些事是不应该去打听的。

sentences.en: Well, let me try and think of how I want to say this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我想想该怎么表达这一点。

sentences.en: Well, I feel like there was a lot of preciousness around asking people about motherhood.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得过去大家在询问别人的母亲身份时，总是带着一种小心翼翼的珍视感。

sentences.en: Oh, and I've been really reflecting on how important it is for young women to hear women talk about the balance of motherhood and work.
sentences.zh: 哦，而且我一直在深刻反思，听女性谈论母亲身份与工作的平衡，对年轻女性来说是多么重要。

sentences.en: It used to be like, oh, it was offensive to ask people about motherhood, but I think it's so important.
sentences.zh: 过去人们会觉得，哦，打听别人的母亲身份是冒犯的，但我认为这非常重要。

sentences.en: Like, it never offended me.
sentences.zh: 比如，这从来没有冒犯过我。

sentences.en: People asked me how I juggled things, or I would ask other women the same things.
sentences.zh: 人们会问我我是怎么兼顾各项事务的，或者我也会问其他女性同样的问题。

sentences.en: You know, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: You've been, I've sort of been thinking about what it is to be a mom in different eras because
sentences.zh: 你一直在，我其实也一直在思考在不同的时代当妈妈意味着什么，因为

sentences.en: there's a pretty big age gap between your oldest two kids and your youngest who's still home with you.
sentences.zh: 你最大的两个孩子和目前还跟你住在一起的小儿子之间，年龄差距挺大的。

sentences.en: Are you different as a parent this time around?
sentences.zh: 这一次作为父母，你有什么不一样吗？

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: I'm exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我精疲力竭。

sentences.en: I'm completely wrung out and tired.
sentences.zh: 我整个人都被榨干了，累得很。

sentences.en: And whenever I lose my cool, I turn to my youngest and I go, you got to call your brother and sister.
sentences.zh: 每当我快要失去理智的时候，我就会转向我的小儿子说，你得给你哥哥姐姐打电话。

sentences.en: They wore me out.
sentences.zh: 他们把我折腾得够呛。

sentences.en: I'm so tired, like eat the cookie, go to bed late, just do it, you know?
sentences.zh: 我太累了，比如吃饼干吧，晚点睡吧，就这么干吧，你知道吗？

sentences.en: But like, think about how it's going to make you feel.
sentences.zh: 但是，想想这会让你有什么感觉。

sentences.en: And then like beyond that, I'm so tired.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我实在是太累了。

sentences.en: I've been, I've been parenting for 25 years.
sentences.zh: 我已经，我已经当了25年的父母了。

sentences.en: And I also know, I also feel very comfortable that I know the little things that aren't as important.
sentences.zh: 而且我也知道，我也很清楚哪些小事其实没那么重要，这让我感到很安心。

sentences.en: Like I had a friend say, I'm not there for pickup.
sentences.zh: 比如我有个朋友说，我没去接孩子放学。

sentences.en: And is that okay?
sentences.zh: 这可以吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: You know, you, you can't be at every soccer game, you know, every morning meeting, pick up, drop off, make the lunch, do the volunteer stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你不可能参加每一场足球赛，你知道，每一个早会、接送孩子、做午饭、做义工。

sentences.en: It's, it's a lot of pressure on women to send the kids to school, have them fully prepared, but also do all the volunteering at the school, around the school.
sentences.zh: 这，这给女性施加了很大的压力，既要送孩子上学、让他们做好充分准备，还得在学校里或周围包揽所有的志愿工作。

sentences.en: That's like unpaid labor, you know?
sentences.zh: 这就好像是无偿劳动，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I am so grateful for the women who show up and do it and include me in it, you know, when I choose to show up.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激那些出席并完成这些工作，而且在我选择露面时把我也包含其中的女性，你知道的。

sentences.en: But that's a whole other set of pressures on women constantly, you know, to show up and be the perfect mom.
sentences.zh: 但这是强加给女性的另一套持续不断的压力，你知道的，要求她们随时出现并成为完美的妈妈。

sentences.en: As we've talked about your parenting of your youngest, I'm also wondering how you look at your oldest and what that looks like in terms of giving her guidance as she kind of
sentences.zh: 既然我们聊到了你对最小的孩子的养育，我也想知道你是如何看待你最大的孩子的，在引导她

sentences.en: makes her own way in the world.
sentences.zh: 在世间开辟自己的道路方面，这又是什么样的？

sentences.en: From your own perspective, as someone who also has had to navigate Hollywood at a young age, you know, what kind of advice do you give her?
sentences.zh: 从你自己的角度来看，作为一个也曾在年轻时经历过好莱坞的人，你知道的，你会给她什么样建议？

sentences.en: Well, it's interesting because last year she turned 25.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有趣，因为去年她25岁了。

sentences.en: And when I was 25, she was a year and a half old and I just done Legally Blonde.
sentences.zh: 而我25岁时，她才岁半，我刚拍完《律政俏佳人》。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: And I was about to start Sweet Home Alabama.
sentences.zh: 我当时正准备开始拍《情归阿拉巴马》。

sentences.en: We just are living very different life existences, realities.
sentences.zh: 我们只是过着非常不同的人生存在状态和现实生活。

sentences.en: And I'm so proud of her for not being anything but herself, not trying to emulate me or be me.
sentences.zh: 我为她感到骄傲，因为她除了做自己之外什么都不是，没有试图去效仿我或成为我。

sentences.en: You know what I'm saying?
sentences.zh: 你知道我在说什么吗？

sentences.en: Not trying to approximate my career or Ava's just cool.
sentences.zh: 没有试图去达到我事业的高度，艾娃就是这么酷。

sentences.en: She's just always been cool.
sentences.zh: 她一直都很酷。

sentences.en: You know, some people are just born cool.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人天生就很酷。

sentences.en: She was just born cool.
sentences.zh: 她就是天生就很酷。

sentences.en: But part of the challenge of being a mother of a 26-year-old woman is learning to back away, learning she doesn't need me in the same ways and that's okay.
sentences.zh: 但作为一个26岁女性的母亲，其中一个挑战就是学会放手，学会她不再以同样的方式需要我，而这没关系。

sentences.en: And soothing my heart when I feel like rejected a little bit.
sentences.zh: 当我觉得有点被拒绝时，要学会安抚自己的心。

sentences.en: But it's not a rejection.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是一种拒绝。

sentences.en: It's actually her—people in my life remind me the alternative would be worse if she was just so needy, needy, needy.
sentences.zh: 这其实是她——我生活中的人提醒我，如果她总是那么依赖、依赖、依赖，那情况才会更糟。

sentences.en: She's just not needy like that.
sentences.zh: 她只是没有那么依赖。

sentences.en: I'm just really proud of who she's become as an individual.
sentences.zh: 我为她作为一个独立个体所成长为的样子感到由衷的自豪。

sentences.en: You know, I have an only child.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只有一个独生女。

sentences.en: She's 12.
sentences.zh: 她12岁了。

sentences.en: I can't imagine the moment when she's going to leave and that's going to be the end of that.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象她要离开的那一刻，那将意味着这一切的结束。

sentences.en: And I've been watching a lot of sort of people sending their kids off to college and sending their kids off into the world.
sentences.zh: 我最近一直在看很多人把他们的孩子送去上大学，把孩子送到外面的世界去。

sentences.en: And you're talking about it feeling lonely and rejected.
sentences.zh: 你在谈论那种感到孤独和被拒绝的感觉。

sentences.en: I'm just wondering how you, you know, have processed that and how you deal with letting your children go.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你是如何，你知道的，消化这一点的，以及你是如何应对放手让孩子们离开的。

sentences.en: Especially children, I have to say, Reese, who, you know, are going to get a lot of scrutiny because they're the child of Reese Witherspoon.
sentences.zh: 瑞丝，我必须说，特别是那些，你知道的，因为身为瑞丝·威瑟斯彭的孩子而会受到大量审视的孩子。

sentences.en: Well, that, you know, we talk about a lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个，你知道的，我们讨论过很多。

sentences.en: But that's, again, something I can't understand because I wasn't the child of famous parents.
sentences.zh: 但这也是我无法理解的事情，因为我不是名人的孩子。

sentences.en: So I help, I encourage them to reach out to people who are in similar situations and they certainly have friends there.
sentences.zh: 所以我提供帮助，我鼓励他们去接触那些处于类似境况的人，他们当然也在那里结交了朋友。

sentences.en: And, you know, the whole thing about how do people treat them as they pursue acting or music or entertainment.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，关于人们在他们追求演艺、音乐或娱乐事业时如何对待他们的问题。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty natural that the child of two actors would want to try acting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，两个演员的孩子想要尝试演戏是很自然的事情。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: I mean, there's this whole discussion, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在有这么一场讨论，对吧？

sentences.en: About Nepo babies, et cetera, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 关于“星二代”等等等等。

sentences.en: Yeah, it just blows my mind.
sentences.zh: 对，这简直让我大开眼界。

sentences.en: Like, is Laura Dern a Nepo baby?
sentences.zh: 比如，劳拉·邓恩是星二代吗？

sentences.en: Like, really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: She's an Oscar winning, incredible part of the fabric of filmmaking for 40 years.
sentences.zh: 她是一位奥斯卡得主，是过去40年电影制作行业中不可或缺的卓越一部分。

sentences.en: And so are her parents.
sentences.zh: 她的父母也是如此。

sentences.en: And it's like, should we not have her be an actress?
sentences.zh: 这就好像，难道我们不应该让她成为一名演员吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think it's also what you do with those opportunities, you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这也是关于你如何利用这些机会，你知道的？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I think my kids have a really good, clear headspace about that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的孩子们对此有着非常健康、清晰的心态。

sentences.en: But back to the point of empty nesting in a certain way, because I have two kids who left home, it's really sad.
sentences.zh: 但回到某种程度上的空巢期这一点，因为我有两个孩子离家了，这真的很伤感。

sentences.en: It's really hard to deal with.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难应对。

sentences.en: I grieved their going to college, and I cried in their rooMs.
sentences.zh: 他们去上大学时我很难过，我在他们的房间里哭过。

sentences.en: And, oh my gosh, one year, one of them didn't come home for Christmas, and I sat in their bed and just cried.
sentences.zh: 而且，天哪，有一年他们中的一个没有回家过圣诞节，我坐在他们的床上独自哭泣。

sentences.en: It's a loss, because you do everything for them.
sentences.zh: 这是一种失落，因为你为他们付出了一切。

sentences.en: You take the food out of your mouth, the coat off your back.
sentences.zh: 你把嘴里的食物省给他们，把背上的外套脱给他们。

sentences.en: You don't sleep.
sentences.zh: 你无法入睡。

sentences.en: You just don't, let's just, you don't sleep, because you're so either taking care of their physical needs when they're little, or when they're older, you're just so worried all the
sentences.zh: 你就是不，咱们直说吧，你根本睡不好觉，因为你要么在他们小的时候照顾他们的生理需求，要么在他们大一点的时候，你整天都在担心

sentences.en: time that they're going to get in a car accident, or they're going to come home, or there's going to be drugs involved.
sentences.zh: 他们会遭遇车祸，或者他们回家时会遇到麻烦，或者会涉及毒品。

sentences.en: You just, I have everywhere that parents have, you know?
sentences.zh: 你就是，我经历过所有父母都经历过的事，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And then one day, it's kind of like, if you've done your job, you did the right things, they go.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，就好像是，如果你尽到了自己的职责，做对了事情，他们就走了。

sentences.en: And it's like, oh, it makes me teary right now.
sentences.zh: 这就好像，我现在说得都要流泪了。

sentences.en: It's just really hard.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难。

sentences.en: But you know you did the right things.
sentences.zh: 但你知道你做了正确的事。

sentences.en: So, and then they become these incredible friends.
sentences.zh: 所以，然后他们成了非常棒的朋友。

sentences.en: Like, Ava will call me and just be like a great friend.
sentences.zh: 比如艾娃会打电话给我，就像一个极好的朋友那样。

sentences.en: Deacon calls me all the time.
sentences.zh: 迪肯经常给我打电话。

sentences.en: We hang out in New York, and he'll tell me about cool restaurants.
sentences.zh: 我们在纽约一起闲逛，他会跟我讲一些很酷的餐厅。

sentences.en: And I'll be like, great, can you get a reservation?
sentences.zh: 然后我会说，太好了，你能订到位子吗？

sentences.en: Because he has, he can get better reservations than I can now.
sentences.zh: 因为他现在能订到的餐厅位子比我还要好。

sentences.en: But it's awesome to have your kids become adults.
sentences.zh: 但看着孩子们长成成年人，这种感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We only have a few minutes left.
sentences.zh: 我们只剩下几分钟了。

sentences.en: What do you see your career going in terms of your acting?
sentences.zh: 就你的演艺事业而言，你觉得未来的发展方向是什么？

sentences.en: Is TV more interesting to you now than movies?
sentences.zh: 现在电视对你来说比电影更有吸引力吗？

sentences.en: No, I kind of, I go back and forth.
sentences.zh: 不，我其实，我在这两者之间摇摆不定。

sentences.en: I love movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱电影。

sentences.en: It's, you know, how I started.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，你知道的，这是我起步的地方。

sentences.en: And I love, I love that television has become this premium storytelling enterprise.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢，我喜欢电视已经变成了这样一个优质的讲故事产业。

sentences.en: I think a lot of building my company was around television.
sentences.zh: 我认为我公司的建立很大一部分是围绕着电视展开的。

sentences.en: And the world of television producing was just so open.
sentences.zh: 电视制作的世界是如此开放。

sentences.en: It was like the wild, wild west that we could do whatever we wanted to.
sentences.zh: 它就像狂野的美国西部，我们可以随心所欲地做任何我们想做的事。

sentences.en: And I have to be so passionate at this point to be acting.
sentences.zh: 到了这个阶段，我对演戏必须充满激情。

sentences.en: I have to love it.
sentences.zh: 我必须热爱它。

sentences.en: Just love it, love it, love it.
sentences.zh: 就是热爱、热爱、热爱。

sentences.en: Because I really like my life, you know, my real life is really good.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的很喜欢我的生活，你知道的，我的现实生活非常美好。

sentences.en: So I have to really feel like, oh, the story has to be told.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须真心觉得，哦，这个故事非讲不可。

sentences.en: And I do feel like that about some of our projects.
sentences.zh: 对于我们的某些项目，我确实有这种感觉。

sentences.en: But it's, it's definitely a different feeling about acting.
sentences.zh: 但这绝对是一种截然不同的演戏感受。

sentences.en: I've also been doing it since I was 14.
sentences.zh: 我从14岁起就开始演戏了。

sentences.en: So I've done a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以我演过很多作品。

sentences.en: I said a lot, I've played a lot of parts.
sentences.zh: 我说过很多，我扮演过很多角色。

sentences.en: I know what I have played when I haven't played.
sentences.zh: 我清楚自己演过什么，没演过什么。

sentences.en: I'm not interested in repeating myself.
sentences.zh: 我对重复自己不感兴趣。

sentences.en: What do you think people don't understand about you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得人们对你有什么误解吗？

sentences.en: So much.
sentences.zh: 太多了。

sentences.en: There's so much people don't know.
sentences.zh: 有太多是人们所不知道的。

sentences.en: I don't talk a lot about things I've been through.
sentences.zh: 我不怎么谈论我经历过的事情。

sentences.en: I will one day.
sentences.zh: 总有一天我会说的。

sentences.en: I'm just not ready yet.
sentences.zh: 我只是还没准备好。

sentences.en: One day I'll tell everything.
sentences.zh: 总有一天我会把一切都讲出来。

sentences.en: I think.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: Is there a Reese memoir coming out?
sentences.zh: 瑞丝的回忆录要出版了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Maybe I'll never write the book.
sentences.zh: 也许我永远也不会写这本书。

sentences.en: My kids know.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们知道。

sentences.en: They know a lot of the things that happen behind the scenes that, you know, some of my really good friends know.
sentences.zh: 他们知道很多幕后发生的事情，你知道的，我一些非常要好的朋友也知道。

sentences.en: But I don't linger on things either.
sentences.zh: 但我也不会对事情恋恋不舍。

sentences.en: I feel like every day is a new opportunity to do something meaningful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得每天都是做有意义事情的新机会。

sentences.en: I don't hold grudges.
sentences.zh: 我不记仇。

sentences.en: I don't dwell.
sentences.zh: 我不纠结过去。

sentences.en: And I think it's what serves me.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是成就我的地方。

sentences.en: It's what pushes me forward.
sentences.zh: 是它推动我向前迈进。

sentences.en: I'm constantly looking to create and not dwell in the old or remember what I was or remember all the wrongs that happened to me.
sentences.zh: 我一直在寻求创造，而不是沉湎于过去、缅怀我曾经的样子，或是记住所有对我不公平的事。

sentences.en: But I do think that would be very, very entertaining.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为那会非常非常具有娱乐性。
